_doc: MKK statistics per year for the stats slide chart (src/charts.py). 2007–2025 values without a note are read off the old statisztika.jpg (Fichtinger's Excel chart, no source table exists; about ±4 on the left axis, ±100 on the right). The definitions of klub, ko100 and tav are not documented. 'missing': series without a 2026 value.

tavrepulo.label: Távrepülők
tavrepulo.note: 2024: 2024 deck ('464'); 2025, 2026: XContest MKK pilot list (pilots with a flight)

repulesek.label: Repülések (jobb tengely)
repulesek.note: 2024–2026: all flights of the MKK contest in our XContest API export (data_keep/flights_export, 2026-10-25); 2024 and 2025 match the old chart. The stats slide's 'feltöltött repülés' (pilot list sum, 5838) is another count

legtersertes.label: Légtérsértések
legtersertes.note: 2021–2024: 2024 deck ('légtérsértések (KO) száma'); 2025: the user in the chat, 2025-11-07 (the old chart showed about 82); 2026: our validation, KO flights (src/README.md, 2026-10-09). No 2020 value in the old chart

ko100.label: 100+ KO
ko100.note: no 2020 value in the old chart
